ch03: Every god they had ever seen had a face.
ch04: It is the black middle of the night at a river crossing, and a man is sending away everything he loves.
ch05: Before the mountain burned for a nation, it burned for an audience of one, and the fire was small enough to fit inside a bush.
ch07: The saddest thing God ever showed a human being, He showed to a man sitting seven hundred miles away from where it happened.
ch08: Before He takes the east road into Jerusalem, He climbs a different mountain, and heaven throws a reunion.
ch09: Seven miles is a long walk when hope is behind you.
ch10: Everything that separates those two crowds comes down to a supper table in Jerusalem, the night before He dies, and to the oldest question in this book, asked by one of His friends.
